lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7-8 vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the branchial region. The blobs increase in diameter and spatial separation as they progress towards the posterior edge of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. Each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark, vertically-oriented linear marking is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, bisecting the first two columns of the lateral spot pattern. The posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin shows minor irregularities or fraying.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-blobs with significantly smaller diameters than the primary flank constellation.
